headless.description: Non-visual package or service. No UI component baseline is implied.

marketing-site.description: Public presentation or marketing surface with a small interactive footprint.

web-app.description: General interactive application baseline. Optional catalogue capabilities become required when the product uses them.

data-heavy-app.description: Interactive application where dense tabular/data exploration is core.

custom.description: Project-defined applicability. Every catalogue item used by the product must still be classified explicitly.

rule: Profile requirements are minimum capabilities, not mandatory screen content. Any optional catalogue capability becomes required for a project once the product implements or depends on that capability.
